Please note that this is a **work in progress**. The official PPG II has not been released yet. **Please do not cite this** as PPG II until it is officially released.

To see details such as synonyms, please browse the data using the [PPG Database Viewer](dataviewer.qmd). You may also access the data through [Rhakhis](https://list.worldfloraonline.org/rhakhis) (live data) or [World Flora Online (WFO)](https://wfoplantlist.org) (biannual snapshots).
For more information about WFO, see [here](wfo.qmd).

```{r}
#| results: asis
lines <- readr::read_lines(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pteridogroup/ppg/refs/heads/main/data/ppg.md"
)

lines <- lines[lines != "# PPG"]

cat(lines, sep = "\n\n")
```
